'''PRANA''' is the compute blockchain of the [[SoapBox]] ecosystem — a proof-of-work, EVM-compatible Layer-1 that you mine with an ordinary computer, and whose mining does '''useful work'''. It is the sister chain to the social chain [[MELEK]], and it is the engine that pays for the ecosystem's artificial-intelligence compute.

== What it is ==

PRANA is its own '''Layer-1 blockchain''', built on '''core-geth'''. It is '''EVM-compatible''' — the same tools as Ethereum (MetaMask, Solidity, Remix, Hardhat, Foundry) — and it is '''Proof of Work''', mined with the '''Etchash''' algorithm (ECIP-1099 — the same algorithm as '''Ethereum Classic''', GPU-mined). It is a '''fair launch''': '''no premine''', no presale, no insider allocation; supply starts at zero and is entirely earned by mining. Tokens issued on PRANA are ERC-20s — we call them '''PRC-20''' (see [https://witness.melek.salon/tokens Token standards]).

== Key facts ==

* '''Chain ID''' — '''712217'''.
* '''Block reward''' — '''2 PRANA''' per block, about every '''13 seconds'''.
* '''Emission decays 10% a year.''' Each roughly one-year "era" the reward drops by a tenth (2 → 1.8 → 1.62 → …). This is a gentle, continuous taper — '''not''' a sudden Bitcoin-style halving.
* '''The "Hathor fee".''' A consensus-enforced '''2%''' of each block is split off to a treasury address — funding the ecosystem's shared AI compute directly from issuance.
* '''EIP-1559 burn.''' Like modern Ethereum, the base fee of every transaction is burned, so heavy use makes PRANA scarcer.

== The idea behind it ==

'''An AI needs GPUs to think, and GPUs cost money.''' PRANA's design goal is to fund that compute from mining rather than by renting cloud until a treasury runs dry — the 2% Hathor fee routes block issuance toward the shared AI compute the ecosystem runs on. A second, '''planned''' earning lane — a '''TASK lane''' for verified AI / GPU compute paid from the same reward pool, beside the classic '''HASH lane''' of Etchash proof-of-work — is a direction on the roadmap, not yet a live consensus feature. Today PRANA is a straightforward Etchash PoW chain; the useful-work lane is being built on top.

== PRANA and KULA ==

Miners earn '''PRANA''' and, alongside it, the reward token '''[[KULA]]'''. KULA is the ecosystem's DeFi / DEX token — '''not''' a stablecoin and not a "backed dollar" (MELEK deliberately ships no such token). See [[KULA]] for what it actually is.

== How to take part ==

* '''Mine it''' at the [https://pool.soapbox.community pool] — Etchash on a GPU, or CryptoNote / RandomX on a CPU, even in the browser. Earn from the first share.
* '''Learn it''' at the [https://witness.melek.salon Witness School] (the pool + how mining works).
* '''Build on it''' — deploy PRC-20 tokens, the [[KULA]] DEX, and dApps, exactly as you would on Ethereum. Point MetaMask at the RPC ''rpc.prana.melek.salon'', read blocks on '''PRANAScan''' (''pranascan.soapbox.community''), and hold PRANA in the '''Akasha''' wallet (''akasha.soapbox.community'') — these public surfaces are launching.

== Where PRANA fits ==

PRANA is the '''compute''' layer of the ecosystem: [[MELEK]] (social), '''PRANA''' (compute / proof-of-work / AI work), and [[KULA]] (DeFi). The apps built on top are [[SoapBox]].

See also: [[MELEK]] · [[KULA]] · [[SoapBox]] · [[Hathor]] · [https://witness.melek.salon/tokens PRC-20 token standards]
